title: IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:
IT Infrastructure Engineer - London

Marshall Wolfe are hiring on behalf of our client, a Senior Infrastructure Support Engineer, to oversee and enhance a complex international technology estate spanning on-premises infrastructure, cloud services, Microsoft 365, networking, cybersecurity, and end-user technologies.


The Role

You'll play a key role in maintaining, securing, and evolving enterprise infrastructure across multiple international locations. Acting as a senior technical escalation point, you'll work closely with internal teams and external technology partners while leading infrastructure projects from design through to delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimise Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualisation, storage, backup and disaster recovery environments.
  • Support and develop Azure infrastructure, including networking, governance, VMs, VPNs and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive and Purview.
  • Lead endpoint management and modern workplace initiatives using Intune and Autopilot.
  • Manage identity and access controls across hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.
  • Oversee network security technologies including firewalls, VPNs and switching infrastructure.
  • Lead global infrastructure projects and coordinate third-party suppliers and MSPs.
  • Support vulnerability remediation, cyber security initiatives and compliance programmes.


Requirements

  • Strong experience within IT Infrastructure
  • Windows Server, VMware and/or Hyper-V environments.
  • Azure IaaS, networking and cloud governance.
  • Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM and Single Sign-On.
  • Microsoft Intune, Autopilot and endpoint security management.
  • Microsoft 365 administration and collaboration platforms.
  • Backup, disaster recovery and enterprise security best practices.
  • Managing vendors, stakeholders and delivering technical projects.


Desirable Skills

  • Palo Alto Firewalls and GlobalProtect.
  • Cisco Switching and Cisco ISE.
  • Citrix / NetScaler.
  • Azure AI Foundry, Power Platform or Power BI/Fabric.
  • ITIL, Microsoft Azure/M365 certifications, CCNA or relevant degree.


Location: London (hybrid - 4 days on site per week)

This is the chance to join a global organisation with excellent career-growth opportunites. Please apply with your CV in the first instance.
